title: Working Example of the Story Analysis Workflow Using Cadence (Python SDK, with Grade/Repair Loop)

story.so_that: I can durably automate complete multi-step workflows of agentic action
story.as_a: Software Engineer, and AI Process Designer
story.i_want: a working example of the Story Analysis Workflow of the SDLC process using a publicly available workflow engine

target_persona.name: Alex - Software Engineer & AI Process Designer

journey.before: Alex manually invokes each SDLC skill (extract-story-intent, analyze-story, draft-implementation-plan, etc.) one at a time, hand-tracking state, retries, and an audit trail across the multi-step Story Analysis Workflow.
journey.during: Alex defines the Story Analysis Workflow as a Cadence Workflow using the Python client SDK, with each of the four SDLC skill steps (extract-story-intent, analyze-story, grade-story-analysis, repair-story-analysis) implemented as a Cadence Activity. A Cadence Worker executes the steps, retries failed Activities per a configured retry policy, loops between grade-story-analysis and repair-story-analysis (capped at 3 attempts) until the analysis passes, and blocks on a Signal to escalate to a human whenever a step is ambiguous, uncertain, or the grade-repair loop is exhausted.
journey.after: Alex inspects the Cadence Workflow's Event History (via the `cadence` CLI or Web UI) to confirm every Activity/tool call ran and how retries/escalations were handled, and reuses or shares the documented Workflow/Activity/Worker code with other engineers for future stories.

capability_breakdown.core_action: Orchestrate the Story Analysis Workflow as a single durable Cadence Workflow (Python client SDK) with four steps, each implemented as a Cadence Activity: (1) extract-story-intent, (2) analyze-story, (3) grade-story-analysis, and (4) repair-story-analysis. If grade-story-analysis reports a score below its pass threshold, the Workflow invokes repair-story-analysis with the current analysis and the grader's feedback to produce a repaired analysis, then re-invokes grade-story-analysis; this grade-repair cycle is bounded to a maximum of 3 attempts before the Workflow stops and escalates to a human via Signal.

recommendation.approach: Implement the Story Analysis Workflow as a single Cadence Workflow using the Python client SDK, with one Activity per step across four steps: extract-story-intent, analyze-story, grade-story-analysis, and the new repair-story-analysis skill. Configure a bounded ActivityOptions RetryPolicy per Activity for transient failures. After grade-story-analysis, branch in the Workflow: if the grade passes, continue; if it fails, invoke repair-story-analysis with the analysis and grader feedback and re-invoke grade-story-analysis, tracking the attempt count in Workflow state and capping the grade/repair cycle at 3 attempts. If still failing after 3 attempts, block on a Signal (guarded by a timer via a Cadence Selector) to escalate to a human.
recommendation.rationale: Cadence's durable Event History satisfies the auditability/traceability acceptance criteria without extra tooling, Activity RetryPolicies directly implement the story's retry-loop requirement for transient failures, and a Workflow-state-tracked attempt counter cleanly bounds the grade/repair feedback loop (ADR-005/ADR-006) without needing external orchestration. Signals provide a state-preserving mechanism to punch out to a human both for step-level ambiguity and for a fully exhausted repair loop. The Python client SDK is used per stakeholder decision; feature-gaps.md should be checked before relying on any Go-only capability.
